name: Jest of the Gutter’s Reprisal
body:
School: Transmutation; Level: jester 9

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Personal

Target: You

Duration: 1 round per level Description: You burrow, climb, or swim your base speed +10 (your choice).
